have h : ∀ (m : List α), ∃ l₁ l₂, List.orderedInsert le a m = l₁ ++ a :: l₂ ∧ m = l₁ ++ l₂ ∧ ∀ (b : α), b ∈ l₁ → (!le a b) = true := by intro m; induction m with | nil => exact ⟨[], [], rfl, rfl, by simp⟩ | cons x m ih => ?_
refine ⟨(l.mergeSort le).takeWhile (fun b => !le a b), (l.mergeSort le).dropWhile (fun b => !le a b), ?_, by simp [List.takeWhile_append_dropWhile], ?_⟩
